Put R(delta)=(1+delta-3delta^2/4)/(1+delta^2/4). Then 0<L_i/e_i<=log2(R(delta))/2<=log2(77/65)/2<1/8. Their combined loss satisfies L_u+L_v<=delta log2(R(delta))/2<delta^2/(2ln2), and also L_u+L_v<delta/8<=Inf_(y1)/20. The same row divergences and remainders hold after tensoring with any common Boolean spectator on independent fresh coordinates.
